sentences.text: Learned counsel present for the respondent No.2 states that after thorough investigation the petitioner has been found to be involved in the offences and since the challan has already been filed and he can raise all these objections before the learned trial court.
Learned
Public Prosecutor also submits that after thorough investigation, the petitioner involvement has been clearly found.
This Court has heard the arguments raised by both the parties.
In the present case, so far as the allegations in the FIR is concerned, the same pertains to the drawing of the amount from the account of the complainant from the Bank.

The petitioner was the Bank Manager at that relevant time and when the transactions have taken place the vouchers bear the signatures of the Bank Manager therefore, his involvement prima facie can not be ruled out.
So far as the contentions of the petitioner is concerned, no misappropriation has been done by him and the charges framed can not coexist.
Since the matter is pending for trial and the objection raised by the petitioner can only be considered by the (Uploaded on 06/03/2026 at 06:52:59 PM)
[2026:RJ-JD:10980] (3 of 3) [CRLMP-1993/2025] learned trial court at the time of taking cognizance or at the stage of framing of the charges.
Any defence taken by the petitioner can be subsequently subject to his proving the case before the learned trial court.

This Court has considered the challan papers filed by the petitioner and therefore, at this stage, is not inclined to interfere as prima facie, involvement of the petitioner has been found by the investigating agency and rest all the contentions.
Accordingly, the present criminal misc. petition stands dismissed.
However, the petitioner would be at liberty to raise all the contentions before the learned trial court at an appropriate stage.
All pending applications, if any, stands disposed of.

(BALJINDER SINGH SANDHU),J 1-suraj/-
